description: Opens the Flaim home as a tab in the current chat: the user's connected current-season fantasy leagues, each team's matchup, roster, standings, and moves, and starter questions, which post into that chat when tapped. It is a UI entrypoint the user opens from a chat, hidden from the model on hosts that support MCP Apps. For league questions or the user's league list, use get_user_session instead. Read-only: it reads the same Flaim league records and saved defaults as get_user_session, and the asks the user kept, plus which Flaim home features are turned on for them, for the page to show (the asks are not part of this result's text), and changes nothing.

prefetch.description: Set only by the Flaim page when it prepares the home in the background before the user opens it, so the call is counted apart from a home open. Leave it out.

name: open_flaim_home_tab
title: My Leagues in Chat
